columns.name: OrgUnitId
columns.description: Unique org unit identifier

columns.name: TopicId
columns.description: Unique topic identifier

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Unique user identifier

columns.name: PostId
columns.description: Unique post identifier

columns.name: ThreadId
columns.description: Unique thread identifier

columns.name: IsReply
columns.description: If post is a reply

columns.name: ParentPostId
columns.description: Parent post Id. Field can be null.

columns.name: NumReplies
columns.description: Number of replies to a post

columns.name: DatePosted
columns.description: Date the post was made (UTC).

columns.name: IsDeleted
columns.description: Is post deleted

columns.name: RatingSum
columns.description: Sum of all ratings for a post

columns.name: NumRatings
columns.description: Number of ratings for a post

columns.name: Score
columns.description: User's score on the post (if graded). Field can be null.

columns.name: LastEditDate
columns.description: Indicates the date when the discussion post was edited (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: SortOrder
columns.description: Display sort order used for the content objects

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Indicates the number of nested hierarchical levels in the discussion post.

columns.name: Thread
columns.description: Discussion thread name. Field can be null.

columns.name: WordCount
columns.description: Indicates the number of words counted in the discussion post. Field can be null.

columns.name: AttachmentCount
columns.description: Indicates the number of attachments associated with a discussion post. Field can be null.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. This information is used to determine which table row occurred first, similar to the way time stamps function in other data sets.
